name: City of San José Surplus Property Donation Program
description: Surplus city property (valued at $1,500 or less) donated to nonprofits, public agencies, and volunteer fire departments when available
fullDescription: Under City Council Policy 1-20, San José's Director of Public Works can donate surplus city property with an estimated value of $1,500 or less to public agencies, volunteer fire departments, and nonprofit corporations.
whatTheyOffer:
- Donated surplus city property valued at $1,500 or less
- Items are posted on the Public Works surplus property page when available
- Availability varies (the list may be empty between donations)
howToGetIt:
1. Must be a public or government agency, volunteer fire department, or nonprofit corporation
2. Check the Public Works surplus property page for items available for donation
3. Submit the Donation Request and Disclaimer Form by email to the Public Works contact listed on the page
4. Arrange pickup of approved donations
keywords: San Jose, surplus property, nonprofit donation, free equipment, office furniture, 501c3, city surplus, Santa Clara County
